notes.title: Falnarion Tactics III v1.4 update out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786184/2526f2898b27ae0c3015b244d183a500d8025381.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786184/93b053b96396dbf284522ef0ec3ec7d1646327d7.png

This is the final update for Falnarion Tactics III.

I hope you have been enjoying the finale of the series and I hope you enjoy the new content. Without anymore delay, let's begin!

-Added in the side quest; Dual Ascension.

-Added in the side quest; Troll's Lair III.

-Added in the side quest; The Last Stand.

-Added in the side quest; Echoes of The Dead V.

-Added in the side quest; The Battle.

-Added in PVP (Must clear the game to access it).

-Added in a new character; Antheima Stoneheart.
 (Can obtain in Troll's Lair III).

-Added in a new character; Nino (From Euclyca).
(Can obtain in Echoes of The Dead V).

-Added in a new character; Mina Astrol (From Euclyca).
(Can obtain in Echoes of The Dead V).

-Added in new dialogue scenes with the new characters in the base camp
menu.

-Added in character bios for the new characters.

-Added in a scene between Lyla and Mina if you unlocked both.

-Changed animations for some tome weapons.

-Added in the status effect "Charmed".

-Added in a few new weapons; Be Mine (Tome), Mistiki (Mina's Katana), Shotgun (Gun), Aquarem (Tome), Watearia (Tome), Drestolfor (Tome) and The End (Sword).

-Changed the icons for Pistol and Rifle.

-Added in six more uses for the Rifle, added in four more uses for the Pistol.

-Added in and changed some battle backgrounds.

-Increased the amount of Seraphic Feathers you can buy in the shop.

-Added in new characters' dialogue to the ending credits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786184/daff7437212cd311548af25bfda21b179a222f9e.jpg

-Added in two new classes to change into; Shadow Slayer (Luna) and Scholar (Whisper and Tei).

That is all and thanks for playing the Falnarion Tactics series!

notes.title: Falnarion Tactics III v1.3 update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786184/2526f2898b27ae0c3015b244d183a500d8025381.png
Falnarion Tactics v1.3 update!

-Added in a new side quest called Land of Tanks.
Play as "The Iron Legend" and defeat enemy tanks alongside allied ones.

-Added in some allies such as The Holy Spirit and an Angel in Chapter 2 (Spiritual Distress) to make it a lot easier. As some people have had difficulty in that mission. Added in a new spellbook: Judgement. (Only usable by The Holy Spirit).

-Fixed the Dragon's animation in Dragon's Lair II, as it was causing errors before.

-Removed some enemies from Chapter One: The Road Ahead.

-You may now get all Falnarion Tactics games in a series bundle for a discount.

Thank you all for the small brief update.

(Happy Valentines Day to all you love birds out there!) -Syukino!
